notes.title: 1.3.15 - Chonkers: The Masquerade
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here's a hefty update bringing both new features and QoL changes for the Owned Cats Screen:

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[h2]Alter appearance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/0384a4c8704923758a1483d7ad813164e4567bd1.gif[/img]

Wishing the most profitable cats had the looks of your favorite breed? Time for a makeover!
When you discover all the cats in a Roll of a certain category (Slim, Chonkers, Space and Space Chonks), you'll be able to modify the looks of any grown cat of the same category into a breed from that Roll.
[i](The change is only visual. Cats still retain their profit values and their chonker/space categories)[/i]

[h2]Re-Roll[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/1b17198d9eb15d2d8c6259625d6ceed37ca5f145.gif[/img]

You're flush with cash, want that particular cat, won't stop until you get it, and now you have the right tool for it. When choosing a new cat after buying a Roll, we added a Re-Roll button to speed up the process and avoid any tedious back and forth.

[h2]Renaming rooms[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/b1eb98734c2785f498a9d403bb4add7375190191.png[/img]

Whether you keep forgetting which room you're putting all the chonkers in, or you just want to change those boring room names, we're very excited to add this highly requested feature.


And there's more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/d77e12e338839a46b51318c4303d349ab6543593.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/5022fc718da8e44bb061cd423204f4bdd883f043.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/c0e67bfcf2434f01ea66080bf5854d3a3538ddce.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/6f83a306664d406eb02fa055c4069f75ebe1d257.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback!
Here's the full list of all the changes:

[h3]v1.3.15 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New feature: Alter appearance
[*]New feature: Re-Roll
[*]New feature: Renaming rooms
[*]You can now change room while grabbing cats, enabling swapping slots between full rooms.
[*]Added a Filters submenu in the Owned Cats Screen to only visualize cats that meet the required filters.
[*]Added a button in the Owned Cats Screen to list only the cats that are in the currently active room.
[*]Added text separators in the Owned Cats Screen when sorting cats by room, rarity or level.
[*]Loft room style: the robovac now struggles when a chonker is put on top of it.
[*]Minor adjustments to cat positions (Zen and Loft room styles)
[*]Realigned elements in the cat details card.
[*]Code optimization to the task refresh cycle to improve consistency.
[*]Some rewording in the task log for better clarity.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issue[/h3]
[list]
[*]Holding down the left mouse button to scroll the dropdown menus in the details and change appearance cards can make you grab cats in the room underneath.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.0 - I call dibs on the couch!
notes.notes:
Pspspsps!
The new update has just been released, and it's a chonky one!
We've introduced many quality-of-life features and adjustments, like the upgradable play area, the revised pricing for the furniture, and an enhanced backup system for your save files. 
Among the latest additions, there's The Loft. A new room style for you to find, and three more items are available in the catalog.

[h2]New room style: Loft[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/0c7b4ff3b4dddba6ced83a3089ce188f28a4f9aa.gif[/img]

[h2]New feature: Toy area upgrades[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/e5a8b265ec8f2ed6fa9436a223e02e9e12dab920.gif[/img]

We've implemented a brand new income bonus based on the amount of items purchased from the catalog. Every room now benefits from a cumulative income bonus, while previously, only lamps and litter boxes provided a passive bonus.
Additionally, the distractions and litter box rewards have been increased to match your current income and remain relevant money sources even during the late game.

Here's a more detailed list of all the changes:

[h3]v1.3.0 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New room style: [i]Loft[/i].
[*]New furniture: [i]Couch[/i] (bench), [i]Speaker[/i] (Tower), [i]Abat-jour[/i] (Lantern).
[*]New toy area upgrades have been added in the catalog.
[*]Overall rebalance of furniture prices.
[*]Income bonus from room furniture has been reworked.
[*]Litter boxes and distractions rewards now scale on the total income.
[*]Increased the wake-up timer bonus from lanterns (from +5s to +15s).
[*]Added a skip choice (don't choose any cat) after buying a roll.
[*]Added a button in the Owned Cats Screen to change sorting from ascending to descending order.
[*]Code optimization of the sorting mechanics making it more consistent.
[*]Added a button on the Breed Discovered pop-up to focus the newly grown cat.
[*]New highlight mode ("Tab" key)
[*]Added shortcut to sell the current selection ("S" and "Delete" key)
[*]Fail-safe added to automatically restore the backup save in the case of save file corruption.
[*]Fixed a bug could potentially corrupt the save file on launch.
[*]Changed the blue rarity color tint to be more distinguishable.
[*]New stars icon added to cats' cards to help identify their rarity.
[*]Cats' room change drop-down menu now indicates occupied slots in each room.
[*]Added visible Steam stat progress on [i]Distractions are no more, and we have clicked them.[/i] achievement.
[*]Added a required input field in the Reset Progress confirmation screen.
[*]Added a tooltip in the Room Style Change screen specifying how to unlock styles.
[*]While editing a cat's name, pressing directional arrows and numbers won't change room (thus closing the selection) anymore.
[*]New Cat (or Cat Rolls) Screen can now be opened even in a full room to check Rolls prices.
[*]Cats won't be highlighted when clicked on while Chill Mode is active.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the litter box to fill each time a cat was sold.
[*]New cat names have been added from the suggestions survey. Thank you!
[/list]

Thank you all for the helpful feedback and your suggestions. See you on Discord!

notes.title: 1.2.6 - Toys 4 Us
notes.notes:
Pspspsps, new update just dropped.

We separated toy styles from toy upgrades, so you can now play with your favorite toy while still having the best exp output! And speaking of exp, the toy effectiveness can now be upgraded up to +50 exp per click.

We also noticed that the late-game can become too slow and grindy for our taste, so we decided to reduce the price for Galactic Rolls down to $25B. Enjoy the space shopping spree!

[h3]v1.2.6 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Separated toy styles from toy upgrades.
[*]Added new toy level upgrade button in the catalog.
[*]Reduced Galactic Roll price (from $131B to $25B).
[*]Added an icon in the tooltip showing from which Roll the cat originates (When picking from a Galactic Roll).
[*]Added an option to sort by breed name in the Owned Cats Screen.
[*]Code optimization in the lantern script.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [i]Worklight[/i] Lantern wouldn't assign the proper time boost.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.5 - The Details Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're bringing some Quality of Life features on the Details card, together with a revamped Owned Cats screen and a new bulk-sell option. Let's take a look:

[h2]Roll and Discovery tooltips, Inspect button[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/fd3884da7e4ed9bcd8ee607d06d3815d3218bdf5.gif[/img]

When examining a cat, you now have two new icons, one identifying which Roll the cat is from, and the other telling you which variations of that breed you have already discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/509a765faecf261adc552bbd17823abe4063dcb8.gif[/img]

In the new Owned Cats screen, each cat card has a magnifying glass button that will make you further inspect the cat by jumping to their room and bringing up their details card.

[h2]New feature: bulk-sell[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/8d9eb657433b2e5915b76e5b453185b46c2037f2.gif[/img]

In need of a big clean up? You can now sell all grown cats (or just the ones who reached max level) with a couple of clicks! Just make sure to lock all the cats that you want to keep with you before that.


Last but not least, there's a new arrival in the catalog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/101cb27e39d660c3fac23feb67911fb99040b7eb.png[/img]

[h3]v1.2.5 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Details Card and Owned Cats Card: added an icon (with tooltip) to identify which Roll a cat is from.
[*]Details Card and Owned Cats Card: added an icon (with tooltip) to see whether the cat has been already discovered as Adult or Chonker.
[*]Owned Cats Card: added a button to go directly to that cat's room and open the Details Card.
[*]Owned Cats screen overhaul.
[*]New bulk-sell option in the Owned Cats Screen.
[*]When buying a new cat, a new line has been added to the bottom of the tooltip showing how many kittens of the same breed you currently own.
[*]New furniture: [i]Torii[/i] (Litter Box)
[*]Changing room style maintains the current furniture equipped, therefore the 20 cats limit has been removed.
[*]The Collection screen now shows the breed name if you have already discovered another variation.
[*]Save/Load code optimization.
[*]Added new cat names from the suggestions survey. Thank you!
[*]Updated the texture of disabled buttons.
[*]The Menu window has been slightly resized to avoid possible conflict between buttons.
[*]Added a border to the dropdown lists.
[*]Fixed the room hourly income tooltip.
[*]Equipping an already bought furniture/upgrade now plays the normal button click sound.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
A quick patch to address some issues with the new Grab feature!

[h3]v1.2.3 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an unintended behaviour that made you able to grab cats when a window was open, thus closing the window.
[*]Increased the timer duration before the grab mode is triggered to 0.4s (grab mode is triggered earlier only by moving the mouse away from the slot while holding down the left click).
[*]Added an option in the menu to toggle the Grab feature off.

[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.2 - Gotta Grab 'Em All
notes.notes:
Pspspsps, we've been planning to add this feature for a while, and now it's finally live!

[h2]New feature: Grab[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/9642e642b55267e7c7c5e63d990cc7bc60387422.gif[/img]

By holding down the left mouse button, you can now grab cats and move them to any free slot, or have them swap place with another cat; in addition to this, all cats will remember their slot even after you close the game.

We're also happy to report that we found and fixed the bug that caused a savefile corruption to some users!

[h3]v1.2.2 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New feature: Grab.
[*]Cats will remember their slot between play sessions.
[*]Cats won't shuffle position randomly on room change anymore.
[*]Fixed a bug corrupting the save file on game launch
[*]Added the current room's income in the tooltip while hovering the money label.
[*]Improved performance when the Task Log is open.
[*]Fixed an issue with cat sprites overlapping incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a glitch where the EXP Booster button would change size when greyed out.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.0 - To the Meown!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're starting 2025 with a big content update:

[h2]New room style: Meown[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/5a907966813d2086a8ce83c8532f2b3e07d00749.gif[/img]

Our third room style is finally here! This lunar playground is the perfect home for your space cats, and it comes with a batch of new themed furniture as well. While the Meown is unlocked by completing tasks, the Toolbox, Rover, and Worklight are for sale in the catalog at any time.

[h2]New feature: Bulk-buy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/ea00cd070b6685324c7891c848f0d9a601d730a2.gif[/img]

The unending pain of having so much money but needing to go back and forth the ui to buy one roll at the time is over. You can now buy multiple rolls of the same kind with a few clicks, and filling rooms to capacity will be a breeze.


But it doesn't stop here! We've been working fixing, improving, and expanding Chonkers, here's the full changelog:

[h3]v1.2.0 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New room style: [i]Meown[/i].
[*]New furniture: [i]Toolbox[/i] (bench), [i]Rover[/i] (Tower), [i]Worklight[/i] (Lantern).
[*]Rolls can now be bought in bulk.
[*]Experience needed for cats in the [i]Cobby Cuties, Exotic Friends,[/i] and [i]Special Snugglers[/i] rolls has been reduced by [b]30%[/b].
[*]Furniture prices have been reduced for every room after the first.
[*]Keep an eye out for new rare distractions flying at full speed across your screen!
[*]The outline of a selected cat will now mirror their rarity.
[*]Added a new loading screen when the game starts and optimized loading times.
[*]Overall performance optimization.
[*]Joypad buttons have been bound (D-pad for room change, Shoulder buttons for left and right clicks, Right Action / Button East for the Esc key function).
[*]Added Activity / Rich Presence for Steam and Discord.
[*]Roll names have been added above each row of the Collection Screen, along with a number tracking how many breeds are yet to be discovered.
[*]Collection Screen has been slightly resized, to hint more at the horizontal scrollbar.
[*]Since it still caused confusion, the Community Marketplace button in the Exp Booster screen has been aptly renamed as such.
[*]Changed Lantern and Bowl positions in the Backyard room style.
[*]Fixed the night light effect for Lanterns in the Backyard room style.
[*]Fixed a graphical glitch in the [i]Oriental Shorthair[/i] Kitten sprite.
[*]Resfreshing news! The "Task resfresh" typo in the task log has been corrected.
[*]Fixed the graphic for the locked version of the sell button in the Cats Screen.
[*]Fixed a mouse conflict with the tooltip while choosing a new cat card, causing unwanted flickering.
[/list]

That is all for now. Our best wishes for a cozy and wonderful New Year to all of you ✨

notes.title: v1.13 - Income Rebalance
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've addressed the issue regarding income levels, which were completely off and dragged the initial pacing of the game longer than expected. The income formula has been revised, resulting in a massive increase for all cats, especially the rarest one. With this change, selling cats won't feel like the only way to make progress steadily.
Additionally, we adjusted Exp requirements for the cats in the first Roll, making the game more engaging early on.

[h3]v1.13 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]General income rebalance for all breeds.
[*]Experience rebalance for the "Moderately Sleepy" Roll.
[*]Hovering on your money label will now show your total daily and hourly income.
[*]New cat names have been added from the suggestions survey. Thank you!
[/list]

Thank you for your continuous feedback and helpful suggestions!

notes.title: v1.11 - Streak rework
notes.notes:
Hi!

Today we've been focusing on the streak system, and have some news about it:
As of now, the streak won't reset anymore if you miss a daily task. Thinking back on it, it felt too punishing and not reflecting at all the vibe of our game.
Some users experienced bugs with lost streaks. To bring everyone up to speed, loading an existing save will now bump your task streak up, as if you've completed each daily task since launch day.

Lastly, the game will now create a backup save file every 15 minutes of playtime. We've had an instance of a bsod while saving, creating a corrupted file. Should something like this happen now, you can replace the broken file with the backup one. Save file paths are:

Windows:
[code]%appdata%/godot/app_userdata/chonkers[/code]
Linux:
[code].local/share/godot/app_userdata/chonkers[/code]
[h3]v1.11 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Streak system rework: streak won't reset on missed daily tasks.
[*]Total distractions clicked achievement goal reduced to a more reasonable amount.
[*]Removed the experience popup while playing with cats that are at max level.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support and feedback,
Cheers!

notes.title: 1.09 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're pretty confident to have found a solution for the bug that caused the very first daily task to not trigger the item reward correctly. For every new user, in case you still don't receive an item drop after your first daily, just restarting the game will fix that and drop your reward.

We're sorry for the inconvenience, and to compensate for it all current users who encountered the bug will receive an extra reward next time they launch the game.

Thanks for your continuous support, and we hope you're enjoying playing Chonkers!
[i]Alessandro[/i]

notes.title: v1.07 Bugfix and Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

[b]First things first, let's address the elephant in the room. The Item Store is gone, dead, and it won't come back. Nobody, not even a necromancer, can resurrect it.[/b]

For those unaware of what I'm talking about, we added an Item Store with an EXP Boost and a Golden Roll (items that could be obtained [b]for free[/b] in-game) thinking it could offer a mean for our players to continuously support us and, at the same time, be rewarded with a modest boost in-game.

Unfortunately, the Item Store has been perceived as a paywall, and the fact that we intentionally avoided advertising the purchasable items (that could not be bought in-game, hence why the lack of the "In-App Purchases" tag) has been seen as we were trying to hide the shop instead.

Additionally, we encountered a bug that was blocking the in-game reward system and these items became unobtainable for many, and it surely didn't help building trust.

We are sorry for the confusion it might have caused and hope that our official statement will help you decide whether Chonkers is a game for you or not.

Said so, we are incredibly grateful for your feedback and the wave of love that Chonkers has been receiving!

[h3]v1.07 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed (hopefully) a bug preventing Steam from triggering the reward item drop upon completing the first daily task. Successive tasks have already been tested and proven to trigger the item drop correctly.
[*] Added a setting to toggle the right mouse click, to be able to play with cats without needing to hold down the mouse button. (Thanks Kirilee from our Discord)
[*] Added an icon in the examination window to further signal when a cat is a chonker, same as in the owned cats screen. (Thanks OldFool2024 from our Discord)
[/list]

Thank you all for sticking with us, despite the initial hiccups 💖

Yours kindly,
Alessandro and Fabiano

P.s. Come chill with other Chonkers lovers in our [url=https://discord.gg/pAjdJJSJxa]Discord[/url]. We're waiting for your feedback, and you're welcome even if you're bringing a bug report with you!
